_comment: PLACEHOLDER : questions factices en attendant les vraies questions du jeu Sous la Surface (à fournir par Lumina Mastery). Garder des identifiants stables.

cards.text: [PLACEHOLDER] What small moment from this week would you like to keep?
[PLACEHOLDER] What gives you momentum right now?
[PLACEHOLDER] What conversation would you like to have soon?
[PLACEHOLDER] Which place feels most like you?
[PLACEHOLDER] What have you learned from someone close to you?
[PLACEHOLDER] Which habit would you like to keep for a long time?
[PLACEHOLDER] What makes you smile for no reason?
[PLACEHOLDER] Which memory often comes back to visit you?
[PLACEHOLDER] What would you say to the person you were five years ago?
[PLACEHOLDER] What deserves more room in your days?
[PLACEHOLDER] Which season feels like you today?
[PLACEHOLDER] Which compliment have you never dared to give?
[PLACEHOLDER] What are you curious about right now?
[PLACEHOLDER] Which object tells a story about you?
[PLACEHOLDER] What promise would you like to make to yourself?
[PLACEHOLDER] What does silence bring you?
[PLACEHOLDER] Who would you like to thank?
[PLACEHOLDER] What feels lighter than before?
[PLACEHOLDER] Which dream are you keeping for later?
[PLACEHOLDER] What would you like people to know about you without having to say it?
